source_title: OKX to list MORPHO (Morpho) for spot trading

scheduled_spot_trading_start.statement: OKX announced that MORPHO/USDT spot trading was scheduled to open at 10:05 UTC on 2024-11-21.

limitations: This record authenticates the project's source check, not an immutable copy of the third-party webpage.
Deposit, call-auction, and withdrawal times are separate facts and are not represented as the listing event.
No separate post-opening confirmation is attached, so lifecycle remains scheduled even though the announced time is in the past.
